name: Extortion and Kidnap-for-Ransom Funding of Terrorist Groups
description: Terrorist and insurgent groups raise funds through ransom, extortion of businesses and diaspora communities, and illicit taxation in areas they control. Payments often appear as unexplained transfers, cash movements by third parties or emergency borrowing.

sources.text: FATF, Organised Maritime Piracy and Related Kidnapping for Ransom (2011)
UN Security Council Resolution 2133 (2014) on kidnapping for ransom by terrorist groups

indicators.name: Urgent transfers described as emergency family or legal payments
indicators.canon: Urgent transfers described as emergency family or legal payments
indicators.desc: Customer receives or sends sudden large transfers framed as emergencies, to unfamiliar parties or accounts abroad.
indicators.ctx: Customer receives or sends sudden large transfers framed as emergencies, to unfamiliar parties or accounts abroad.
indicators.fp: Genuine medical and legal emergencies produce similar urgency.

indicators.name: Business pays recurring unexplained amounts to regional intermediaries
indicators.canon: Business pays recurring unexplained amounts to regional intermediaries
indicators.desc: Operators in conflict-affected areas make periodic payments to individuals labelled as security, fees or consultants.
indicators.ctx: Operators in conflict-affected areas make periodic payments to individuals labelled as security, fees or consultants.
indicators.fp: Private security and facilitation fees can be lawful but need documentation.

indicators.name: Cash collected from multiple unrelated individuals then moved abroad
indicators.canon: Cash collected from multiple unrelated individuals then moved abroad
indicators.desc: Collection of funds across diaspora members or business owners followed by consolidated cross-border transfer.
indicators.ctx: Collection of funds across diaspora members or business owners followed by consolidated cross-border transfer.
indicators.fp: Community fundraising for family and festivals is common.

indicators.name: Crisis consultancy or ransom-response payments without documentation
indicators.canon: Crisis consultancy or ransom-response payments without documentation
indicators.desc: Payments to intermediaries described as negotiators or consultants with limited contracts or oversight.
indicators.ctx: Payments to intermediaries described as negotiators or consultants with limited contracts or oversight.
indicators.fp: Professional crisis response firms exist and are lawful.

indicators.name: Kidnap and ransom insurance claims with unusual payee structure
indicators.canon: Kidnap and ransom insurance claims with unusual payee structure
indicators.desc: Claims paid to third parties or in cash with limited verification of the event.
indicators.ctx: Claims paid to third parties or in cash with limited verification of the event.
indicators.fp: Claim handling often involves confidential intermediaries.

indicators.name: Transfers following threat or abduction reports from region
indicators.canon: Transfers following threat or abduction reports from region
indicators.desc: Payments from relatives or employers rise coincident with publicly reported kidnappings or extortion campaigns.
indicators.ctx: Payments from relatives or employers rise coincident with publicly reported kidnappings or extortion campaigns.
indicators.fp: Remittance spikes occur around disasters and conflicts for many reasons.

indicators.name: Payments routed through informal or non-bank agents in affected areas
indicators.canon: Funds routed via informal agents or cash couriers into conflict areas
indicators.desc: Funds reach regions with armed groups through informal value transfer, MVTS or cash couriers.
indicators.ctx: Funds delivered via cash couriers or informal agents into regions where armed groups operate.
indicators.fp: Informal channels are often the only access in fragile regions.

indicators.name: Local taxation language in invoices or payments
indicators.canon: Local taxation language in invoices or payments
indicators.desc: Documents reference levies, tolls or taxes payable to non-state bodies or local commanders.
indicators.ctx: Documents reference levies, tolls or taxes payable to non-state bodies or local commanders.
indicators.fp: Poor translation and informal local terminology may be misleading.
